data.body: Vendor check 2026-11-23 PST. Claude Code 2.1.311, scratch HOME/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (no user config touched, no real PAT): 'claude mcp add-json -s user' stored "Bearer ${MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI}" literally; a user-scope entry pointed at a local HTTP listener received 'Bearer dummy-not-a-pat-123' when MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI=dummy-not-a-pat-123, so user-scope headers expand at connect time. Copilot CLI: official 'Adding MCP servers' page is silent on expansion; maintainer close of github/copilot-cli#1232 says ${VAR} works in HTTP headers; changelog 1.0.108 'use ${NAME} to reference a host environment variable'. Not exercised locally for Copilot (needs an authenticated session). Fix committed (4e4023a3e46) in worktree beaver-mcp-docs; guard tests fail on the unfixed doc (docs/mcp-client-setup.md:95,174 header-arg) and example (claude/.mcp.json header-arg) and pass after. make verify running.
